autoauth.title: Auto-Auth
autoauth.no_accounts: Add an account to enable automatic sign-in.
autoauth.plaintext: Saved logins are stored in plaintext on disk.
autoauth.builtin: Uses the built-in Microsoft login by default.
autoauth.timeout: Sign-in times out after three minutes.
autoauth.error.no_login: Add this account again with Microsoft sign-in.
autoauth.error.storage_detail: Check that the config directory is writable and try again. Your previous saved accounts have been preserved.
autoauth.error.login_detail: Sign-in was cancelled, timed out, or could not complete. Check your connection and Microsoft account, then try again. A missing built-in login registration must be fixed by the mod distributor.
autoauth.progress.retry_later: Service unavailable. Retrying after a short delay…
autoauth.progress.failed: Sign-in failed. Retry or add the account again.
autoauth.progress.no_account: Add a Microsoft account to continue.
